label: Materialized and read the whole pinned NE I.7, ST I q.5 a.1 and i ii q.94 a.2
summary: Materialized and read the whole pinned NE I.7, ST I q.5 a.1 and I-II q.94 a.2. Added four bounded source readings distinguishing role excellence, excellent rational activity over a complete life, ultimate due perfection and reason-regulated inclination. Existing GoodnessFromDesirability and naturalistic-realism reason-omission results already cover the proposed formal bridge and its failure; no duplicate theorem was created. Functional criterion assignment, the normative priority of human ends, correctness of rational regulation and categorical authority remain open for all compared views. Source fidelity, rejected inferences and a symmetric positive comparison are persisted in docs/notes/natural-goodness-function-and-authority.md. No root premise is added, removed or discharged. Reassessed issue #563 on 2026-11-10 against origin/main fd93f6387: traced the Catholic answer sequence and actual first-precept body, corrected completeness criterion to scope accountability, preserved Railton obligation/reason rival, and rejected jurisdiction/belief-authority imports as moral bridges. Existing typed omission and naturalist ascription results are reused, not duplicated. Detailed recursive term audit, draft provisional judgment, acceptance gaps and next rational-nature/harmful-deliberator test are in the existing linked note. Positive universal application premise remains underived; issue not complete. Continuation tests the explicit agency/self-reason/universalization argument: joint relabeling preserves diagonal self-concern; beneficiary-fixed transfer under self-reasons is equivalent to universal protection reasons. Full, diagonal and empty controls and a private/equal-sum payoff discriminator are in the new agency neutrality result (solution-present, final certification pending). The existing note preserves the injury-aware effective-deliberator scenario, structural-surrogate boundary, strongest constitutive-justice and reciprocity replies, same-case Railton/Boyd/primitive/planning comparison, and substantive equal-standing warrant gap. Local zero-axiom elaboration does not establish actual rationality or moral reasons. Scope reassessment: bare symmetry argument resolved, wider substantive justice/standing defense remains open. Incorporated independent base-audit repair: rational regulation licenses sufficient inclusion, not a formal necessary condition.
